newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-JUVENTUS SCORE BIGGEST WIN OVER MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-JUVENTUS SCORE BIGGEST WIN OVER MILAN.

text.p: Juventus handed AC Milan a humiliating 6-1 thrashing in the champions' own San Siro stadium on Sunday to go six points clear in the Italian first division.
With their European Cup semifinal first leg against Ajax Amsterdam just three days away Juventus held nothing back in a brilliant display.
Two goals from Yugoslav Vladimir Jugovic and a penalty by French international Zinedine Zidane had them 3-0 ahead after an hour.
Christian Vieri's fourth in the 70th minute signalled Milan's capitulation and Nicola Amoruso added a fifth before the home side claimed their solitary goal through Marco Simone.
New Italian international Vieri's second completed Juve's biggest victory over their old rivals who had shown recent signs of a resurgence under Arrigo Sacchi after a crisis-ridden season.
Milan fans demonstrated their anger by gathering under the directors' box and yelling "Sack him" in reference to Sacchi.
